evidence.quote: The articles in this section describe how you can implement application lifecycle management (ALM) using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Dataverse.

ALM is the lifecycle management of applications, which includes governance development and maintenance. Moreover, ALM includes these disciplines: requirements management, software architecture, development, testing, maintenance, change management, support, continuous integration, project management, deployment, release management and governance.
Source control should be your source of truth for storing and collaborating on your components.
Continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform such as Azure DevOps that allows you to automate your build, test, and deployment pipeline.
Unmanaged solutions are used in development environments while you make changes to your application.
Unmanaged solutions can be exported either as unmanaged or managed. Exported unmanaged versions of your solutions should be checked into your source control system.
managed solutions should be generated by exporting an unmanaged solution as managed and considered a build artifact.
Admins easily configure automated deployment pipelines in minutes rather than days or weeks.
Connections and environment variables are provided upfront and validated before the deployment begins.
same solution artifact must pass through pipeline stages in sequential order.
Pipelines deploy solutions as well as configuration for the target environment such as connections, connection references, and environment variables.
Pipelines, or solutions in general, don't contain data stored within Dataverse tables.
We recommend using Azure DevOps or GitHub for this scenario.
Customizations and audit log saved automatically and are easily accessible. Out-of-the-box analytics provides better visibility within a central location.
Licenses granting premium use rights are required for all managed environments.
data policies allow administrators to control access to these connectors in various ways to help reduce risk in your organization.
latency for full enforcement is 24 hours. In most cases, it's within an hour.

claims.wording: Power Platform ALM spans apps, automation, sites, agents and Dataverse; executives should manage it as one governed delivery path.
Use source control as truth, build changes in unmanaged solutions, and export managed solutions as downstream build artifacts.
Promote the same artifact through ordered stages; configure each target, and move Dataverse table records separately.
Automate delivery with pipelines and CI/CD; Microsoft documentation points to Azure DevOps or GitHub for some scenarios.
Before production, check DLP connector controls, tests, analytics, approvals and managed-environment licensing.

knownGaps: The selected sources do not prove tenant-specific rollout, entitlement, licensing, region availability, or feature readiness.
Detailed GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps Build Tools task syntax was not quoted; CI/CD alternatives are framed from ALM and pipeline guidance.
Monitoring is grounded only in pipeline analytics and audit-log visibility, not a complete production observability architecture.
Dataverse relationships and table security are not quoted directly by these four sources; the narrative uses Dataverse data and table-record deployment boundaries instead.
No ROI, cost-savings, adoption, or customer outcome statistics are asserted.
